notes.title: Upcoming playtest soon and demo
notes.content:
Hey guys!
Just wanted to quickly give an update to the game.

Things have been going slower than usual if I'm being honest, but the good news is that a playtest is coming soon!

What's the difference between the demo and the playtest? Well, expect a few things to be slightly less balanced than usual.
Oh yeah, and there is also a brand new tutorial, a whole new map to explore, brand new battle mechanics, color palettes, and more!

Yeah yeah, I admit, I've given myself a small pass and decided to give in to scope creep JUST THIS ONCE, but only so that the game can be the best it can be (I'm developing it like it will be my last one after all!)

Oh, and just a heads up. The old demo has now been deactivated on Steam but can still be accessed on other platforms. The old demo doesn't really represent the whole scope of the final game anymore.

Sorry for any delays or long wait times, but I promise PROMISE it will be worth the wait, and I promise the playtest will happen sometime really soon!

Thanks for reading!


(psst... don't forget to join the Discord for sneak peeks!)
https://discord.gg/JpFg6FABRm

notes.title: New name and moving forward
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Just wanted to let everyone know that the game now has a new name:
[h1]SiliCorp Systems[/h1]
The change was made due to an upcoming (presumably) big project from a big company having the same name. 

Please note that the game will remain the same, only the name has changed!

In other news, there is a new demo build to reflect the changes, featuring tweaks to the title screen sequence and some huge optimizations regarding the game's monitor lighting effects.

Also, there is a Discord server now! I'll be posting regular updates there.
Please feel free to join:
https://discord.gg/JpFg6FABRm


That is all for today, see you all in a few weeks!

notes.title: New Next Fest Demo!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I've been working really hard for the past few months and managed to squeeze a brand new demo out just in time for Next-Fest!

This demo represents the final product. Essentially part one of the final game. What you see here is what you'll see on release, so any and every feedback is crucial and awesome!

OH I almost forgot: The game also has Brazilian Portuguese localization.
More languages will definitely come, but you'll probably have to wait until a bit after release. 

Well, see you guys soon! (I promise.)

notes.title: Demo out now!
notes.content:
Hey, just letting everyone know that the demo is out now!

Decided to release early since I'm not really a big company with a huge press release :)

Hope you all enjoy it!

notes.title: Demo releasing on November 8th!
notes.content:
Hi everyone.

Sorry for the delays, but the demo is finally complete now, and I can say with 100% certainty that it will release this Friday, November 8th!

Can't wait for everyone to try it out.

See you soon!

notes.title: Demo Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

First of all, I'd like to thank you all for the overwhelming support!
Solo-developing this game while managing a full-time job has been quite the challenge, so thank you.

Now, onto the actual news: A demo is coming soon!

Things have been progressing nicely, and I finally feel comfortable with where the game currently stands.

When will it come out? I don’t have a specific date yet, but definitely in the coming weeks.

I really hope you all enjoy it :)

Until next time, bye bye!
